title: Clean simulation with bounded head positions
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and suppose it computes $y$ from $x$ in $t$ steps using at most $s$ work-tape cells. The clean simulation of $M$, started in its initialization state on $x$, has some run time $T$ at which it is halted, its output is $y$, every work-tape cell is blank, and every work-tape head is at the origin. At every time from $0$ through $T$, each work-tape head lies within distance $s$ of the origin.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet
The space used by $M$ through time $t$ is at most $s$
